The '''2024 TPM 25th Anniversary Open''' was a [[Players Committee]] [[GEMP]] league for the 25th anniversary of ''The Phantom Menace''. It ran from 8:00 pm Eastern on 24 April 2024 (0:00 GEMP time) until 8:00 pm Eastern on 19 May 2024, in [[Open]]. [[Tom Kelly]] finished first.<ref name="tpm25structure">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84427 TPM 25 Events! (Structure, Rules, Accomplishments List, Prizes)], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (9 April 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011700/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84427.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="tpm25end">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1425245#p1425245 TPM 25 Open Event - Accomplishments List], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (16 May 2024).</ref><ref name="tpm25standings">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1425598#p1425598 FINAL STANDINGS: TPM 25 Events], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (28 May 2024).</ref>

Registration was 15 GEMP gold. Games were posted to a blind table, with a 45-minute timer for each player, a six-game minimum for participation prizes, and a 12-game ceiling. Standings counted 3 points for a win and 1 point for a loss.<ref name="tpm25structure">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=84427 TPM 25 Events! (Structure, Rules, Accomplishments List, Prizes)], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (9 April 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011700/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84427.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Prizes ==

Players with six or more games were posted for a foil AI full slip of [[Your Thoughts Dwell On Your Mother]], a random sparkly Episode I Light Side foil full slip while supplies lasted, a ''Tatooine: Skywalker Hut (V)'' foil slip, a PC green booster pack, and the GEMP foils [[P-59]] and Queen Amidala AI. The top 8 received an Invisible Hand border-breaking AI and a PC red booster pack. The top 4 received 150 GEMP gold, and 5th through 8th received 100. The top 8 also received the GEMP AIs [[First Light]] and [[Resolute]], and the winner received the GEMP AI [[Kylo, Master Of The Knights Of Ren]]. GEMP prizes were awarded on 26 May 2024. The other prizes were entered on the prize spreadsheet on 28 May 2024.<ref name="tpm25prizes">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1424591#p1424591 PRIZE SUPPORT: The Phantom Menace 25th Anniversary Events], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (30 April 2024). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261123011631/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t84208.html Internet Archive].</ref>

Accomplishments paid a Lord Sidious foil slip and PC gold booster packs. The 28 May 2024 sheet lists 13 foil slips and 32 gold packs.<ref name="tpm25acc">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1425600#p1425600 TPM 25 Open Event - Accomplishments List (+ Prizes Awarded)], Jnapolit31, Players Committee forum (28 May 2024).</ref>
